wireContract.wireDateTime: positive epoch-millisecond WireLong using the existing Yudao Long serializer
wireContract.approvalDetailExtension: only FULL projection adds leadTimeCompliance; all F-CUT-005 fields, permissions, headers, error mappings and allowedActions remain unchanged

fields.scheduledTime: WireDateTime frozen from the locked task
fields.planSubmittedAt: WireDateTime frozen from the submitted immutable plan revision
fields.actualNaturalDays: Integer; scheduled business date epochDay minus plan-submitted business date epochDay

ApprovalDetailV2.field: LeadTimeCompliance for new V2 A/B approval instances; JSON null for C/D and pre-F-CUT-008 instances

detail.successExtension: CommonResult<ApprovalDetailV2> for FULL; FINAL_RESULT_ONLY and REASSIGNMENT_ONLY remain exact F-CUT-005 projections

decisionIsolation: leadTimeCompliance is display-only and is not an input to review items, allowedActions, route, approve/reject guards or task state transitions
strictJson: the snapshot codec rejects missing/extra keys, unknown rule versions/types and wrong wire types
